name: volc-agent-launchpad
description: Agent Launchpad with the Go MandateFlow provenance-sensitive MCP reference monitor.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/web && npm run build -w @launchpad/server
scripts.check:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run test:server && MANDATEFLOW_REQUIRE_GO=1 npm run check:mandateflow
scripts.check:app: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run check:app && npm run check:mandateflow
